news.headline: Nektar Shares Surge as Investors Cheer Lilly Verdict and Bullish Analyst Targets
news.summary: NKTR shares jumped roughly 15% the day after the $90M Lilly verdict, with the stock trading near $59 as several sell-side analysts maintain double-digit upside price targets. Momentum was reinforced by renewed attention to the positive REZOLVE-AD Phase 2b data ahead of the pending REZOLVE-AA durability readout.

news.headline: Eli Lilly Hit With $90M Verdict In Nektar's Rezpeg Breach Suit
news.summary: A California federal jury found Eli Lilly breached the implied covenant of good faith and fair dealing in its Rezpeg co-development deal with Nektar, awarding Nektar $90 million. The award was well short of the roughly $1 billion Nektar had sought at trial.

news.headline: Wedbush Cuts Nektar Price Target to $50 From $80, Keeps Neutral
news.summary: Wedbush lowered its price target on Nektar while maintaining a Neutral rating, citing litigation risk and a more cautious view on near-term catalysts. The cut came just ahead of the Lilly jury verdict.

news.headline: Nektar Therapeutics Stock Falls Sharply as Jury Deliberates in Lilly Rezpeg Dispute
news.summary: NKTR shares dropped roughly 9.6%-11% as the jury deliberated in the Eli Lilly breach-of-contract trial, reportedly after jurors asked questions suggesting a low or no-damages outcome was possible. The stock swung sharply into the following day's verdict.

news.headline: Nektar Therapeutics Enters Quiet Period Ahead of REZOLVE-AA Durability Data
news.summary: Nektar announced a quiet period beginning September 8, 2026 ahead of the public release of 24-week off-treatment follow-up data from its Phase 2b REZOLVE-AA alopecia areata study. The quiet period signals the durability readout is approaching.

news.headline: Nektar Announces Publication in The Lancet of Positive Phase 2b REZOLVE-AD 16-Week Induction Results
news.summary: Nektar's rezpegaldesleukin Phase 2b atopic dermatitis induction data were published in The Lancet, reinforcing the drug's efficacy profile ahead of its planned Phase 3 (ZENITH AD) program. The publication added independent validation to earlier topline results.

catalysts.label: REZOLVE-AA 24-week off-treatment durability data (alopecia areata)
catalysts.detail: Phase 2b durability readout testing whether hair-regrowth responses to rezpegaldesleukin persist after stopping treatment; a key differentiator versus competing alopecia areata therapies and a prerequisite for advancing to registrational studies.

catalysts.label: ZENITH AD Phase 3 program initiation/progress (atopic dermatitis)
catalysts.detail: Registrational Phase 3 program for rezpegaldesleukin in atopic dermatitis, building on the positive Phase 2b REZOLVE-AD results now published in The Lancet.

catalysts.label: Q3 2026 earnings report
catalysts.detail: Nektar is expected to report third-quarter 2026 financial results in early November, which should update cash runway (extended into 2027 after recent equity raises) and pipeline timelines.

catalysts.label: Potential appeal/post-trial motions in Lilly Rezpeg litigation
catalysts.detail: Following the jury's $90M verdict against Eli Lilly (versus the ~$1B sought), either side may pursue post-trial motions or appeal, which could affect ultimate recovery and timing of any payment to Nektar.

pulse: Nektar just won a jury verdict against Eli Lilly over the Rezpeg collaboration breach, securing $90 million -- a win in principle but far below the ~$1 billion sought -- and shares surged roughly 15% the following day as investors focused on the litigation resolution and reaffirmed bullish analyst targets. Attention now shifts to the imminent REZOLVE-AA 24-week durability data (quiet period since Sept 8) in alopecia areata, alongside the recently Lancet-published positive REZOLVE-AD atopic dermatitis data supporting the planned ZENITH AD Phase 3 program. With Q3 earnings expected in early November and cash runway extended into 2027, the stock remains highly newsflow-driven and volatile around both legal and clinical catalysts.
